lines: Power on the device normally
In the app drawer, open System Updates
Click the physical button next to the home button and open Ultimobile Toolkit
Enter the code 000000
Click Enable Toolkit Menus, Hidden Menus, and enable
Under Advanced Options, open USB Provisioning Menu
Click 'DM + Modem + ADB' and press OK
Open UPST
Log in using the relevant details
Ensure the device is selected in the left portion of the view screen
Enter the MIN/MDN
Click Provision
A dialog will appear to advise the provision has been completed successfully
Power on the device normally
Navigate through the welcome screen menu to the home screen
Open the dialer and Enter the code: ##366633#
Choose to enable DM Mode
Open UPST
Log in using the relevant details
Ensure the device is selected in the left portion of the view screen.
Enter the MIN/MDN
Click Provision
A dialog will appear to advise the provision has been completed successfully.
Power on the device normally
Open the dialer and enter the code: ##3424#
Enter the SPC Code : 000000
Tap DIAG and choose enable
Open UPST
Log in using the relevant details
Ensure the device is selected in the left portion of the view screen.
Enter the MIN/MDN
Click Provision
A dialog will appear to advise the provision has been completed successfully.
Power on the device, connect it to the PC, and run Mobilink.
Opening Mobilink will enable the drivers UPST needs to provision

Close Mobilink by right clicking the signal bar icon in the system tray and selecting Exit. Mobilink must be closed to continue.
NOTE : Mobilink can be used to change the device SSID and WiFi password under Advanced Settings.
